'''Iron Man''' is a constructed Star Wars CCG event format in which every card that is lost, placed out of play or discarded is physically destroyed, and each deck is played only once. [[Decipher]] ran it as a non-sanctioned side event at [[DecipherCon 1999]].<ref name="dc99-ironman">[http://www.decipher.com/calendars/event/mainevents/deciphercon/events/ironmanevents.html DecipherCon 1999 – Event Descriptions: Iron-Man Events], Decipher. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20011005153720/http://www.decipher.com/calendars/event/mainevents/deciphercon/events/ironmanevents.html Internet Archive].</ref>

* '''Type:''' constructed
* '''Defined by:''' Decipher (1999)
* '''Card pool:''' the normal constructed pool; four decks per player (2 Light Side, 2 Dark Side)
* '''In use:''' 1999 (DecipherCon 1999)
* '''Also called:''' Iron-Man Events (Decipher's event description)
* '''GEMP:''' none

== Card pool ==
Decipher's description: "This constructed deck format for Star Wars and Star Trek adds new meaning to the word 'lost'. Whenever a card is lost, placed out of play or discarded, you must physically destroy it! Tear it in half, screw it into a ball, eat it - whatever! Just know that you won't be using it again!"<ref name="dc99-ironman" />
* Each Star Wars player brings four decks (2 Light Side, 2 Dark Side); the decks may all differ, and each is played only once.
* Standard tournament rules and current rulings apply, except that destroyed cards "may not be reused, retrieved, taken back from that pile etc."
* Four games for Star Wars, normal constructed pairing, standard game time, no final confrontation, free entry.<ref name="dc99-ironman" />

== History ==
An early DecipherCon 1999 schedule put a Star Wars "Iron Man" Constructed Deck tournament on Thursday 11 November, 1–5 p.m.<ref name="dc99-events">[http://decipher.com/calendars/event/mainevents/deciphercon/events.html DecipherCon – Event Schedule], DecipherCon 1999, Decipher. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20000122042301/http://decipher.com/calendars/event/mainevents/deciphercon/events.html Internet Archive].</ref> The later schedule lists Iron Man (SW.11) on Friday 12 November, 10 a.m.–3 p.m., and Sunday 14 November, 8 a.m.–1 p.m.<ref name="dc99-fri">[http://decipher.com/calendars/event/mainevents/deciphercon/events/fri_events.html DecipherCon 1999 – Event Schedule (Friday)], Decipher. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20000708001407/http://decipher.com/calendars/event/mainevents/deciphercon/events/fri_events.html Internet Archive].</ref><ref name="dc99-sun">[http://decipher.com/calendars/event/mainevents/deciphercon/events/sun_events.html DecipherCon 1999 – Event Schedule (Sunday)], Decipher. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20001026063736/http://decipher.com/calendars/event/mainevents/deciphercon/events/sun_events.html Internet Archive].</ref> Results are on [[DecipherCon 1999 Iron Man]] and [[DecipherCon 1999 SW Iron Man]].

At [[DecipherCon 2000]] Decipher used the same destroy rule for a sealed-deck event, [[Easy Come, Easy Go Sealed Deck]].<ref name="dcon-sw-events">[http://www.decipher.com/deciphercon/2000/events/starwarsccg.html Star Wars Customizable Card Game events], DecipherCon 2000, Decipher. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20010126213800/http://www.decipher.com/deciphercon/2000/events/starwarsccg.html Internet Archive].</ref>
